title: Visualize calibration evolution in labeling and timeline playback
description: Each classifier card exposes a space-efficient confidence reliability graph alongside Recall, Precision, Accuracy (always that order). Show predicted confidence on x-axis, observed correctness on y-axis, perfect diagonal, bin support and calibration error with uncertainty caveats; distinguish calibrated head from raw decision passthrough. Timeline current position/Next/Previous/Play selects the latest recorded per-classifier snapshot at or before that point, never future snapshots. Curve updates visually as labels and optimizations progress; allow inspection of snapshot/window/head provenance and matched before/after calibration where available. Older history lacking snapshots says unavailable, no synthetic backfill presented as recorded evidence. Use light/dark system styling and accessible graph summary/tooltips. Acceptance: fixture playback crosses multiple cycles and proves curves change at correct events, reverse seeking restores prior curve, classifier filter works and no model calls occur during playback; iPad graph does not steal labeling space.

This fixture is UI evidence, not optimization improvement evidence. Actual iPad/dark graph-space acceptance remains open; no real labels or paid model calls changed.
